record: level, tool, premises and status as in STXlib's verification programme, section 6; a discharged obligation records the source hash it was proved against

obligations.statement: capabilities runs only when not_null(record); otherwise returns GF_STATUS_INVALID_ARGUMENT, unchanged.
Unless not_null(record), capabilities changes nothing observable.
capabilities runs only when record_size >= host_capabilities_size_1_0; otherwise returns GF_STATUS_INVALID_ARGUMENT, unchanged.
Unless record_size >= host_capabilities_size_1_0, capabilities changes nothing observable.
When several of capabilities's refusals apply, the first of capabilities_record, then capabilities_record_size is the one reported.
read_clipboard_text runs only when not_null(required) and (not_null(buffer) or capacity == 0); otherwise returns GF_STATUS_INVALID_ARGUMENT, unchanged.
Unless not_null(required) and (not_null(buffer) or capacity == 0), read_clipboard_text changes nothing observable.
